name: pr-pulse
description: Live pane of a repo's open pull requests: checks, review bots, enforced rules, review threads and the commits that address them, and which agents are working on each PR.

pollSeconds.description: How often to ask GitHub for fresh PR status, in seconds.
pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)

autoOpen.description: Open the PR pane on session start when the repo has open pull requests.
autoOpen.title: Open pane automatically

statusLine.description: Pin a one-line PR summary under the prompt while the repo has open pull requests.
statusLine.title: Status line summary

toasts.description: Toast when a check fails, a reviewer leaves new threads, or a PR merges.
toasts.title: Toasts on changes
